name: zsnd_sample_set_init_by_name
description: zSndSampleSet_InitByName finds a registered sample set by name and dispatches to zSndSampleSet::Init, preserving the null-result behavior for missing names.
known_limits: tier S verification for this function is accepted: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs COFF byte compare passes with 0 unmasked mismatches after 8 relocation bytes masked; Binary Ninja body is 12 bytes and the VC object body is 16 bytes with 4 trailing VC NOPs trimmed. Broader sample-set cluster tier S remains separate debt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a0860 validates the zSndSampleSetRegistry_FindByName call followed by a direct zSndSampleSet::Init dispatch on the returned pointer.
The empty-set smoke verifies named registry lookup, Init return 1 for an unloaded empty set, resourcesLoaded update, repeat initialization return 0, and missing-name/null Init return 0.
The loose-file smoke verifies the named dispatch into a sample set that resolves and initializes a loose WAV-backed sample.
